name: DKG Memory MCP Server
description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing DKG V10 memory (Working and Shared Memory in Round 1) as MCP tools, so any MCP-capable client can read, write, share and query DKG memory without custom HTTP wiring.

security.notes: Write authority limited to Working Memory writes and SWM share (seals by default). No Verifiable Memory publish tool is exposed in Round 1 scope; VM promotion requires an explicit human-gated CLI action in a later round. Secret redaction applied before any literal leaves the process. No external network egress: the only host contacted is the DKG node it is installed against (127.0.0.1 by default), which the registry contract does not count as egress.

promotionPath: WM -> SWM (seals by default, publish-ready) -> VM (later round, explicit human CLI gate only)
fitNotes: Transport-agnostic MCP tooling layer exposing DKG memory as standard MCP tools. Round 1 scope: WM + SWM only. No vm/publish tool exposed (Verifiable Memory is a later round and requires an explicit human-gated publish). No UI endorsement/voting tools (disallowed by bounty rules). Secret redaction applied before any literal leaves the process. Smoke-tested live against a DKG V10 node (Base Sepolia testnet): KA create -> WM write -> SPARQL recall verified end-to-end.
